info.title: Patent Intelligence API
info.description: Agentic RAG for multi-source patent intelligence. Research assistance only: not legal advice.

schema.title: Response List Chunks Documents  Document Id  Chunks Get
Response Search Chunks Search Chunks Post

post.description:
Answer a question with cited evidence.

pipeline="agentic" (default): the LangGraph agent picks tools and sources.
pipeline="baseline": fixed retrieve-then-generate over the local index.
Returns 200 for both answered and 'insufficient_evidence' outcomes; check `status`.

Answers with the user's preferred pipeline; follow-ups are rewritten using the
conversation (memory) and answers are scoped to the attached documents.
Attach a document from your library or an imported patent (no upload).

schema.title: Response System Info System Info Get
Response List Sources Patents Sources Get

post.description:
Compare 2–4 sources aspect by aspect. The response's `comparison` holds the table;
every cell cites evidence from its own source.

Takes ~1–3 minutes with local models: features, search, then one check per
feature × document.
